title: Modest accuracy on mid-sized datasets without strong regularization
description: When trained on mid-sized datasets such as ImageNet without strong regularization, ViT models yield modest accuracies a few percentage points below ResNets of comparable size.
canonical_description: lower accuracy than CNNs on mid-sized datasets without strong regularization

evidence.quote: When trained on mid-sized datasets such as \imagenet without strong regularization, these models yield modest accuracies of a few percentage points below ResNets of comparable size.
